texts.preamble: Rajanna T vs United India Ins Co Ltd on 1 August, 2025 Kabc020115782024 Before The Motor Accident Claims Tribunal Court Of Small Causes, At Bengaluru. (Scch-24) Presided Over by Smt. Roopashri, B.Com., Ll.B., Xxii Addl., Scj & Acjm, Member - Mact, Bengaluru. Dated:- This the 1st day of August 2025 M.V.C. No.1768 of 2024 Petitioner: Rajanna .T. S/o Thapasachar, aged 52 years, R/at No.203, Lakshmi Thapaswi Nilaya, Opp. Renuka Yallamma Temple, Near Hoysala Layout, Amruthahalli, Bangalore-560092. (By Sri.H.V.Kumaraswamy, Advocate)
texts.facts: This claim petition is filed by the petitioner under Section 166 of Indian Motor Vehicles Act, seeking compensation for the injuries sustained by him in a road traffic accident. 2. The case of the petitioner is as follows:- That on 10-10-2023 at about 05-30 p.m., the petitioner was discharging traffic duty at Nagawara ring road, Near Manyataw Gate No.2, Nagawara, Bangalore. At that time the driver of Cab bearing Reg.No.KA-03/AK- 7189, drove the said vehicle in a rash and negligent manner and dashed against the petitioner, result of which the petitioner sustained grievous injuries. Immediately the petitioner was shifted to Baptist Hospital for first aid, then he was shifted to Wockhardt Hospital, wherein he took treatment as an inpatient. So far, the petitioner has spent more than Rs.75,000/- towards treatment and other incidental charges. He has to incur future medical expenses also. 3. Prior to the accident, the petitioner was hale and healthy. The petitioner was working as Assistant Police Sub Inspector, at Hennur Police station, Bangalore and drawing sum of Rs.42,000/- per month. Due to the injuries sustained in the accident, the petitioner had not attended the duty for nearly 61 days and not in a position to do the said work as earlier. He has suffered pain and sufferings, permanent disability and other pecuniary and non-pecuniary damages. 4. Respondent no.1/ the insurer of Cab bearing Reg.No.KA-03/AK-7189 has filed written statement and contended that the driver of the Cab was not holding valid driving license and the said vehicle was not having valid R.C, Permit and FC as on the date of accident. It is further contended that the offending Cab is not at all involved in the accident and the said vehicle was falsely implicated for unlawful gains. It is further contended that accident in question has occurred due to the negligent act on the part of the petitioner himself. 5. Respondent no.2/ the RC owner of the Cab bearing Reg.No.KA-03/AK-7189 has filed written statement and contended that he is the owner of the said vehicle and same was insured with the 1 st respondent and the policy was in force as on the date of accident. He further contended that the driver of his vehicle was holding valid driving licence and alleged accident has occurred due to the negligence on the part of the petitioner, that there was no negligence on the part of the driver of his vehicle. 7. The petitioner got examined himself as Pw1 and marked Ex.P1 to Ex.P13 and closed evidence from his side. The respondent no.1 and 2 have not adduced their evidence.
